entities.summary: Jiří Voskovec, known in the United States as George Voskovec, was a Czech-American actor. Throughout much of his career, he was associated with actor and playwright Jan Werich. In the U.S., he is known for his role as the polite Juror #11 in the 1957 film 12 Angry Men. George Voskovec was a poets & playwrights from Sázava (1905-06-19, Sázava–1981-07-01). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
